info.title: The OpenMixer plugins' labels a surface translates: section titles, choice labels and preset names

OMX_PLUGIN_LABELS_BALANCER.description: The labels omx balancer shows that a surface translates: its panel's section titles (section.<section key>), its enumerated parameters' choice labels (choice.<parameter symbol>.<value>) and its factory presets' names (preset.<preset id>), each x-text the English text as declared. Its parameters' names stay English and are no word. Generated by tools/gen.mjs from the declaration and the preset files; the translations are in the catalogs.
OMX_PLUGIN_LABELS_BALANCER.x-why: Section titles, enum values and preset names are translated, parameter names stay English (owner decision 2026-11-11); each translated text gets a key and one English source sentence (omx-contract#2), carried by an existing words item (omx-plugins#18).
